clarify_reference_objects: clarify reference objects in a Droidlet interpreter command when candidates are missing or ambiguous
cc1_to_dlf: convert a REF_NO_MATCH clarification class into a dialogue logical form with nearby candidates
retrieve_action_dict: retrieve the action dictionary from an interpreter's event sequence that references a given object
build_dlf: build a dialogue logical form dictionary with clarification type, candidates, and action data
sort_by_closest: sort candidate memory nodes by euclidean distance to a reference location within a proximity radius
